children: South Korea’s current account surplus widened to USD 46.11 billion in August 2026, up from USD 42.08 billion in July.

The goods account surplus increased to USD 46.81 billion in August from USD 40.43 billion in July, with exports surging 82.1% yoy to USD 104.80 billion, while imports climbed 23.8% to USD 57.99 billion.
Exports surged, boosted by strong growth in semiconductor exports amid the global AI boom.

title: South Korea Current Account Surplus Widens
